critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~830 lines; still monolithic. Splitting into routers/services (auth, market, projects, ledger, investments, properties, dashboard) is recommended before adding more features.

PIN endpoint /api/shares/unlock currently just returns 200 on correct pin — no session flag stored on server; unlock state lives only in client sessionStorage. This means an attacker who calls list_investments can still see shares. If privacy is a real concern, gate /api/investments (or filter type='shares') behind a server-side unlock flag or short-lived signed cookie. Current design is 'security theatre'.
market_quote_sync uses yf.Ticker(...).info which can be slow/flaky and rate-limited by Yahoo; caching for 5min is good but consider longer TTL or fallback to fast_info only.
Dashboard aggregation loops (contributions/loans per project) issue N+1 queries; fine for a single user but could be replaced with $lookup aggregation.
loan_metrics amortizing formula still assumes all drawdowns occurred at start_date — retroactive drawdowns would be misrepresented. Not new to iteration 2.
